cards.example_en: Community groups that knit blankets for local shelters combine practical support with opportunities for social interaction.
cards.example_zh: 为当地收容所编织毯子的社区团体，将实际援助与社交机会结合起来。
cards.explain_zh: k不发音；过去式和过去分词可用knitted或knit。

cards.example_en: The clown made a tiny dog from a balloon.
cards.example_zh: 小丑用一个气球做出了一只小狗。
cards.explain_zh: clown around意为耍宝；称人clown也可能带贬义。

cards.example_en: A ripe blueberry rolled off my spoon onto the table.
cards.example_zh: 一颗熟蓝莓从我的勺子上滚到了桌上。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词，复数把y变为ies：blueberries。

cards.example_en: Her kindness made our new neighbour feel welcome.
cards.example_zh: 她的体贴让新邻居感受到了欢迎。
cards.explain_zh: 指善良品质时不可数；指具体善举时可数。

cards.example_en: We could hear the waterfall long before we saw it.
cards.example_zh: 还没看见瀑布，我们就远远听到了水声。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词：一处瀑布用a waterfall。

cards.example_en: The noodles were too spicy, so I ordered rice.
cards.example_zh: 面条太辣了，所以我点了米饭。
cards.explain_zh: spicy指香料味浓或辣；hot也可指温度高。

cards.example_en: My student visa arrived just before the flight.
cards.example_zh: 我的学生签证在起飞前不久才办下来。
cards.explain_zh: visa是签证，passport是护照；通常需凭护照申请签证。

cards.example_en: My student visa arrived just before the flight.
cards.example_zh: 我的学生签证在起飞前不久才办下来。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My brother plays rugby every Saturday with his friends.
cards.example_zh: 我哥哥每周六都和朋友们打英式橄榄球。
cards.explain_zh: 通常指英式橄榄球，不等于美式橄榄球。

cards.example_en: A tiny green bug landed on my sleeve.
cards.example_zh: 一只绿色小虫落在了我的袖子上。
cards.explain_zh: 口语中bug可泛指小虫；技术语境常指程序错误。

cards.example_en: A software bug can disrupt essential services, highlighting the importance of thorough testing before release.
cards.example_zh: 软件错误可能导致基本服务中断，这凸显了发布前进行全面测试的重要性。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The children built a spaceship from cardboard boxes.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们用纸板箱做了一艘宇宙飞船。
cards.explain_zh: spaceship可数；spacecraft的单复数形式相同。

cards.example_en: The warm soup brought instant comfort after our walk.
cards.example_zh: 散步回来后，热汤立刻让我们感到舒适。
cards.explain_zh: instant作形容词表示即时的；in an instant表示转眼间。

cards.example_en: Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.
cards.example_zh: 数字平台让人们即时获取教育资源，但稳定的网络连接仍然必不可少。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The pianist smiled before playing her favourite song.
cards.example_zh: 那位钢琴演奏者微微一笑，开始弹奏她最喜爱的歌曲。
cards.explain_zh: pianist指演奏者；乐器钢琴是piano。

cards.example_en: A professional pianist usually needs years of disciplined practice as well as opportunities to perform publicly.
cards.example_zh: 职业钢琴家通常既需要多年严格的练习，也需要公开演出的机会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She does yoga on a mat beside the window.
cards.example_zh: 她在窗边的垫子上练瑜伽。
cards.explain_zh: 练瑜伽用do或practise yoga，不用play。

cards.example_en: Take the second exit at the roundabout near the park.
cards.example_zh: 在公园附近的环岛从第二个出口驶出。
cards.explain_zh: 作形容词指不直接，如a roundabout answer。

cards.example_en: Take the second exit at the roundabout near the park.
cards.example_zh: 在公园附近的环岛从第二个出口驶出。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Small fishing boats floated in the sheltered bay.
cards.example_zh: 小渔船漂浮在避风的海湾里。
cards.explain_zh: bay主要指海湾；停车或装卸语境中指专用区域。

cards.example_en: Small fishing boats floated in the sheltered bay.
cards.example_zh: 小渔船漂浮在避风的海湾里。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The delivery failed because our address details were incorrect.
cards.example_zh: 由于我们的地址信息有误，配送未能成功。
cards.explain_zh: incorrect比wrong正式，常用于答案、信息或数据。

cards.example_en: Incorrect information shared online can undermine public understanding of health issues and influence important personal decisions.
cards.example_zh: 网上传播的错误信息会妨碍公众理解健康问题，并影响重要的个人决定。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: You did a terrific job fixing that old bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 你把那辆旧自行车修得真棒。
cards.explain_zh: 常用于口语赞扬；别与terrible“糟糕的”混淆。

cards.example_en: You did a terrific job fixing that old bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 你把那辆旧自行车修得真棒。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Many students realise the importance of time management when they begin balancing academic work with paid employment.
cards.example_zh: 许多学生开始兼顾学业与有偿工作时，才意识到时间管理的重要性。
cards.explain_zh: 英式常写realise，美式写realize；可接that从句。

cards.example_en: Many students realise the importance of time management when they begin balancing academic work with paid employment.
cards.example_zh: 许多学生开始兼顾学业与有偿工作时，才意识到时间管理的重要性。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She placed a biscuit on the saucer beside her cup.
cards.example_zh: 她把一块饼干放在茶托上，紧挨着杯子。
cards.explain_zh: saucer是杯子下的小碟；flying saucer指飞碟。

cards.example_en: We helped ourselves to fresh fruit at the breakfast buffet.
cards.example_zh: 我们在自助早餐处自行取用了新鲜水果。
cards.explain_zh: 作“自助餐”时t不发音；动词“猛击”读/ˈbʌfɪt/。

cards.example_en: She grows herbs in small pots on her balcony.
cards.example_zh: 她在阳台上的小盆里种香草。
cards.explain_zh: 在阳台上用on the balcony，不用in。

cards.example_en: We watched a documentary about penguins after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们看了一部关于企鹅的纪录片。
cards.explain_zh: 作名词指纪录片；documentary evidence指书面证据。

cards.example_en: A warm bath is wonderfully relaxing after a busy day.
cards.example_zh: 忙碌一天后，泡个温水澡让人格外放松。
cards.explain_zh: relaxing形容事物令人放松；relaxed形容人感到放松。

cards.example_en: I felt uncertain about which jacket to buy.
cards.example_zh: 我拿不定主意该买哪件夹克。
cards.explain_zh: 人没把握用uncertain about；事情未定用remain uncertain。

cards.example_en: I felt uncertain about which jacket to buy.
cards.example_zh: 我拿不定主意该买哪件夹克。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We bought some sandwiches before boarding began this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上开始登机前，我们买了些三明治。
cards.explain_zh: 作名词指登机等过程；也可作board的现在分词。

cards.example_en: The art room is on the top storey of this block.
cards.example_zh: 美术教室在这栋楼的最高一层。
cards.explain_zh: 英式storey复数为storeys；美式拼作story。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: Check the width of the sofa before buying it.
cards.example_zh: 买沙发前先确认一下它的宽度。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词wide，名词width，动词widen。

cards.example_en: She sprayed a little perfume on her wrist.
cards.example_zh: 她在手腕上喷了一点香水。
cards.explain_zh: 表示身上用了香水常用wear perfume，而非put perfume。

cards.example_en: My cousin studies engineering and builds small robots at home.
cards.example_zh: 我的表哥学工程，平时在家制作小型机器人。
cards.explain_zh: 表示学科或技术领域时不可数；engineer可指工程师。

cards.example_en: Eating only biscuits for dinner is an unhealthy habit.
cards.example_zh: 晚餐只吃饼干是个不健康的习惯。
cards.explain_zh: unhealthy可指事物伤身，也可指身体状况差。

cards.example_en: The penguin waddled across the rocks towards the sea.
cards.example_zh: 那只企鹅摇摇摆摆地走过岩石，朝大海走去。
cards.explain_zh: 企鹅是不会飞的鸟；并非全都生活在南极。

cards.example_en: Lena proudly showed her swimming certificate to her grandparents.
cards.example_zh: 莉娜自豪地向祖父母展示了她的游泳证书。
cards.explain_zh: certificate泛指证明或资格证书，不一定是学位。

cards.example_en: A professional certificate can improve employment prospects, but employers also value practical experience.
cards.example_zh: 专业资格证书可以改善就业前景，但雇主也重视实践经验。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The film was so dull that I nearly fell asleep.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我差点睡着。
cards.explain_zh: 形容刀刃时指“钝”，形容活动时指“无聊”。

cards.example_en: An electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
cards.example_zh: 一处电路故障让我们的厨房一片漆黑。
cards.explain_zh: electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。

cards.example_en: Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.
cards.example_zh: 定期检查电气设备可以降低人口密集的住宅楼和工作场所的火灾风险。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We booked our train tickets two weeks in advance.
cards.example_zh: 我们提前两周订好了火车票。
cards.explain_zh: in advance可独立用；接事件用in advance of。

cards.example_en: Publishing consultation dates well in advance allows more residents to participate in local planning decisions.
cards.example_zh: 早早公布咨询会日期，可以让更多居民参与地方规划决策。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I was disappointed when rain cancelled our beach picnic.
cards.example_zh: 下雨导致我们的海滩野餐取消，我很失望。
cards.explain_zh: disappointed形容人的感受；disappointing形容令人失望的事物。

cards.example_en: Fasten your helmet before you get on the bicycle.
cards.example_zh: 骑上自行车前，先扣好头盔。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词：戴头盔用wear a helmet。

word.example_en: Community gardens offer a terrific opportunity for residents to exercise outdoors while developing stronger social connections.
word.example_zh: 社区花园为居民提供了极好的机会，让他们在户外锻炼的同时建立更紧密的社会联系。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: The long-term effects of remote working remain uncertain, particularly for younger employees entering the labour market.
word.example_zh: 远程工作的长期影响仍不明确，对刚进入劳动力市场的年轻员工而言尤其如此。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: A small electrical fault stopped the washing machine yesterday.
word.example_zh: 昨天一个小小的电路故障让洗衣机停止了运转。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
